remarks: Dreaming of a beautiful coastal lifestyle? Swimming, boating, and paddleboarding are just steps from this stunning home in the coveted Rowayton Beach Association. Every detail of this designer's own residence has been thoughtfully curated - from custom paint and floor-to-ceiling finishes to hand-selected door handles and custom-picked light fixtures throughout, both interior and exterior.  The fresh, modern interior boasts an open floor plan bathed in beautiful natural light, with beautiful hardwood floors and recessed lighting throughout - added in full when the home was purchased, as none existed. The chef's kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, striking Calacatta marble countertops and backsplash, and a waterfall center island that flows seamlessly into the dining room and living room with vaulted ceilings, fireplace, and glass slider doors opening to the private backyard retreat.  No detail was overlooked and no budget was spared - from the Calacatta marble throughout to the floating marble sinks and designer tile in every guest bathroom, every finish in this home was chosen with intention and an uncompromising standard. Custom drapery and Hunter Douglas power blinds dress the great room and master bedroom. This is not a house that was built to a budget. It was built to a vision.  Upstairs, the tranquil primary suite feels like a treehouse retreat - vaulted ceilings, a private balcony, and birdsong drifting in as you start your morning.
